<b>Multibinder</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Blue|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It extends the duration of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s [[Bind]], but makes Binding heal an additional Mask.

== Usefulness ==
With Multibinder equipped, [[Bind]]ing consists of 2 consecutive Binding animations, each lasting 0.8 seconds, with each part healing 2 Masks. This heals 4 total Masks compared to the usual 3, but takes ~40% longer to complete the Bind.<ref group="Note" name="Duration">The increase to Bind duration varies based on Crest and whether [[Injector Band]] is also equipped; see [[Bind#Modifiers|table of Bind durations]]</ref>
* During [[Beast Crest]] Bind, it instead slows the initial bind speed and allows Hornet to heal up to 4 Masks during Fury rather than 3.
* Hornet can still benefit from the first half of the healing if the Bind is interrupted afterwards.
* If Hornet is infested with [[Muckmaggot]]s, the first Bind will remove the Muckmaggots then the second bind will heal as normal, healing 2 Masks in total.
* Useful during tricky platforming sections or during exploration, where the increased Binding time is not an issue.

== How to Acquire ==
Purchased from [[Frey]] in [[Bellhart]] for {{R|880}} after completing the <i>[[My Missing Courier]]</i> Wish.
